name: Residente Temporal Rentista

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a guaranteed, stable monthly income of at least USD 2,500 (from a source other than employment in Costa Rica, e.g. dividends, rental income, annuities), deposited via an authorised Costa Rican financial institution, guaranteed for a minimum of 2 years.
requirements.fix_path: Document and deposit qualifying income for the required 2-year guarantee period.

requirements.blocker_text: Rentista status holders may not perform remunerated work (manual or intellectual) in Costa Rica -- an ongoing restriction of the status rather than a qualifying eligibility test, so not modelled as a hard pass/fail gate.

evidence_required.document: Bank certification of guaranteed monthly income (USD 2,500+) for 2 years

sources.title: Navas & Navas (Costa Rican immigration law firm) -- Categorías Migratorias summary
Consortium Legal -- Reglamento de la Ley 9996 (investor/rentista/pensionado work restriction, quoted from the regulation)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Costa Rica's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: this is one of Costa Rica's oldest, most consistently-cited residency categories (predating Ley 9996) and the USD 2,500/month figure is corroborated across many independent tier-3/4 sources -- but migracion.go.cr's own pages returned HTTP 403 throughout this pass, and the direct text of the base Ley General de Migración y Extranjería (No. 8764) Article 79 was not independently fetched to confirm this exact figure at tier-1 (only the DGME-adjacent dhr.go.cr Título VI text, fetched for cr_permanent_residence, confirmed the category exists and named it 'rentistas' without repeating the dollar figure). pr_after_months (36) reflects the general 3-consecutive-years-of-temporary-residence route to permanent residence (Article 78), per cr_permanent_residence's own tier-1 sourcing.
